"The Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2023, which was approved by the cabinet on 5th July 2023, is a revised version of the bill that was released for public consultation on 18th November 2022. This bill is the first Act of the Parliament of India to use "she/her" pronouns instead of the usual "he/him" pronouns, reflecting a more inclusive approach. The bill is expected to undergo further additions and refinements over time.
